source.title: FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 3, Chapter 3, indicative crop water needs
source.notes: Indicative ETcrop/ETc ranges over the total growing period. Values vary with climate, crop duration and management; they are scenario ranges, not field measurements.

requirements.applicability: Indicative seasonal crop evapotranspiration range used for consistent crop comparison.
limitations: Excludes land preparation, puddling, seepage, percolation, conveyance loss and irrigation inefficiency.
Must not be labeled gross paddy irrigation demand.

requirements.applicability: Generic FAO bean range used as a provisional proxy for mung bean.
limitations: Not a Sri Lankan cultivar-specific measurement.
Actual demand depends on climate, planting date, maturity group and crop duration.
Not a Sri Lankan cultivar-specific measurement.

requirements.applicability: Generic FAO bean range used as a provisional proxy for cowpea.
limitations: Not a Sri Lankan cultivar-specific measurement.

requirements.applicability: Generic FAO sorghum/millet range used as a provisional proxy for finger millet.
limitations: Not a Sri Lankan finger-millet cultivar-specific measurement.

requirements.applicability: Generic FAO bean range used as a provisional proxy for black gram.
limitations: Not a Sri Lankan cultivar-specific measurement.

requirements.applicability: Indicative seasonal crop evapotranspiration range for pepper used as a chilli proxy.
limitations: Not a Sri Lankan chilli cultivar-specific measurement.
